newsitem.title: USA: Elbit gets FDA approval for scanner.
newsitem.headline: Elbit gets FDA approval for scanner.

text.p: Elbit Medical Imaging Ltd said Wednesday that its subsidiary, Diasonics-Vingmed Ultrasound (Elbit-Ultrasound) of Santa Clara, California, has received marketing clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its premium System-V-Eliter scanner.
The company said more than 100 units have already been installed outside the U.S., and Diasonics-Vingmed will start shipment of the system within the U.S. during the second quarter of 1997.
Elbit Medical makes and sells medical diagnostic systems and equipment, operates medical centers, and trades in various medical products.
